    """Tile the grid vertically in a reflected 3-panel sequence and mirror columns."""

    indices = list(range(len(grid) - 1, -1, -1)) + list(range(len(grid))) + list(range(len(grid) - 1, -1, -1))
    return [list(reversed(grid[i])) + list(grid[i]) for i in indices]
